ruleUpdate: On Intel Xeon 6 (8 memory channels per CPU, 16 channels dual socket), legacy 6-channel memory capacities (such as 1,152 GB achieved via 12x 64GB + 12x 32GB on Gen10) cannot be satisfied with 12 DIMMs without leaving 2 channels unpopulated per CPU and suffering a 25% throughput penalty. Symmetrical population mandates 16 DIMMs (1DPC) or 32 DIMMs (2DPC). Present 1,536 GB (16x 96GB P69729-F21 @ 6400 MT/s) for full 1DPC capacity surplus, or 1,024 GB (16x 64GB P69728-F21 @ 6400 MT/s) for CapEx optimization with documented 128GB delta (INV-184).
